name: Pangolin Addon (CLI)
description: Installs the official Pangolin CLI on the Proxmox host or into an existing LXC and enables Site mode (`pangolin up site` — the Newt replacement), Machine Client mode (`pangolin up` — VPN), or both. One binary, two components. Existing standalone Newt installs are detected and migrated in place, reusing the same site credentials.

notes.text: Components: Site tunnel (expose private resources to Pangolin, userspace WireGuard, no TUN) and/or Machine client (join the host/LXC into the Pangolin network as a device, needs /dev/net/tun). The CLI binary installs once and both components can run side by side as separate services.

Site mode: create a site in the Pangolin dashboard first, then copy the Site ID, secret, and endpoint. Existing standalone Newt installs (with /etc/newt/newt.env) are detected and migrated in place — no new credentials needed.
Client mode: create a machine client in the Pangolin dashboard first, then copy the client ID, secret, and endpoint.
Run on the Proxmox host (not inside a container). Choose Proxmox host or an existing LXC, then select which components and enter credentials.

Host install: the host is directly connected to Pangolin (site can expose everything the host can reach; client joins the whole host to the VPN). Prefer an existing LXC for isolation. LXC targets must be Debian, Ubuntu, or Alpine.
Client mode in an LXC adds /dev/net/tun passthrough to the container config and restarts the CT if needed.

Manual update — host: `update-pangolin-site` / `update-pangolin-cli`. Existing LXC: `pct exec <CTID> -- update-pangolin-site` (or `update-pangolin-cli`). Does not overwrite an app's `/usr/bin/update`.

Unattended (site, host): `var_mode=site var_target=host var_pangolin_endpoint=https://pangolin.example.com var_site_id=ID var_site_secret=SECRET bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oraad/proxmox-scripts/main/tools/addon/add-pangolin.sh)"`

Unattended (client, LXC): `var_mode=client var_target=101 var_pangolin_endpoint=https://pangolin.example.com var_client_id=ID var_client_secret=SECRET bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oraad/proxmox-scripts/main/tools/addon/add-pangolin.sh)"`

Legacy aliases still accepted (site mode): `var_newt_id` / `var_newt_secret`. The old addon URLs `tools/addon/add-pangolin-site.sh` and `tools/addon/add-pangolin-cli.sh` remain as wrappers that force site or client mode.
